title: Meeting notes & summaries

body.text: Paste the transcript or raw notes and have Claude summarize them into
decisions · action items (who, what, when) · open issues
— turn a one-hour meeting into a summary the team can read in 2 minutes.

example: "Summarize these meeting notes, split into: decisions / action items with owner names and deadlines / topics to discuss further"

title: Useful before the meeting too

body.text: The AI helps across the whole cycle:
before — draft an agenda from open items / after — summarize and draft the follow-up email
— a meeting with a clear agenda finishes faster, and a follow-up sent right away keeps action items from getting lost.

example: "From last meeting's summary and the open tasks, draft a 30-minute agenda for tomorrow, ordered by priority"

question: What should a good meeting summary include?

options.text: Decisions, action items, and open issues

question: What does a complete action item consist of?

options.text: Who does it, what they do, when it's due

question: How can the AI help before a meeting?

options.text: Draft an agenda from open items and the previous summary
Attend the whole meeting for us

question: Before a meeting, how would you use Claude to help?

options.text: Draft the agenda and the questions to ask

question: After a meeting, what should you use Claude for?

options.text: Summarize into notes and action items
